meta.notes: Keys are recipe product ids (data/valio-recipes.json products / ingredient productId). aimoProducts are Aimo product codes from the product data file, one per pack size, sorted by netWeightKg = net weight of one base unit (one piece). weightSource: productData = unitConversions; name = pack size in the product name; nameVolume = volume in the name taken as 1 l = 1 kg (approximate); namePieceInCase = base unit is a case (KI) and only the piece size is known, so the case weight is unknown; recipeUrl = pack size in the recipe product URL. unitsPerSalesUnit = base units in one salesUnit (e.g. KI case of 5), so one ordered sales unit weighs netWeightKg * unitsPerSalesUnit. Confidence: high = name matches with pack size removed; medium = one word differs (see note); reviewed = checked by hand; probable = checked by hand, judgement call (see note); not_in_catalog = checked, no such product in the file; unmatched = needs review. packHint 'sanko'/'suurpakkaus' means the recipe means a bulk pack. ingredientLinks: recipe ingredient id -> synthetic recipe product id (900001 and up) for generic ingredients that have no recipe product; it applies in every recipe using that ingredient.
